family: R18-B breakthrough: 1m-range realized-volatility regime filter on frozen majority_1x (new information channel, never tested)
hypothesis: Trailing 1m realized volatility (past-only information the 5m book does not encode as a filter) separates signal quality: keeping majority_1x signals only when 24h 1m vol is in-band improves monthly net without collapsing fills. Different from round16 1m micro-trend DIRECTION (dead both ways) and from v12 5m-vol regime (dead standalone): this is 1m RANGE/volatility magnitude, not direction.

vol_formula.note: Trailing 24h = 1440 1m bars with close_time in (S-24h, S], i.e. 1m opens S.floor('min')-1439min .. S.floor('min'), where S = signal_time = 5m candle close_time. Strictly causal: every 1m bar must satisfy close_time <= S (asserted at runtime).
vol_formula.returns: r_i = ln(close_i / close_{i-1}) for i=1..1439 over the 1440 closes (1439 log-returns).
vol_formula.std: sample std with ddof=1 over the 1439 log-returns.
vol_formula.annualized: vol_ann = std * sqrt(365.2425*24*60); sqrt factor = 725.2235517411166. Scaling is monotonic so tercile assignment is invariant to the year convention; convention disclosed here.

coverage_policy.keep_rule: A signal is vol-computable iff ALL 1440 expected 1m bars are present AND each has close_time <= signal_time (causal); else DROPPED, count reported, NEVER extrapolated.
coverage_policy.control_full: control branches run on all 94 frozen signals (reproduction gate; untouched).
coverage_policy.vol_branches: low/mid/high run on vol-computable signals in their band only. Different N per band is the disclosed filter effect, not a bug.
coverage_policy.precrawl_probe: Read-only probe BEFORE backtests (no tuning): L=5 full=79/94 (matches B-1mentry); L=1440 full=19/94, dropped=75/94. Pooled distribution over the 19 computable vols only.

bands.note: Terciles of the pooled 19-vol distribution, computed BEFORE backtests (read-only probe above). Thresholds frozen here; driver asserts recomputed pooled distribution matches within 1e-9 and applies the rule below.
bands.quantile_method: numpy.quantile linear, q=[1/3, 2/3] over sorted pooled vols

control: control_1x (94 signals, frozen geometry) must match B4 majority_1x published normal (+165.17829563633006% total_return 1.6517829563633004, -20.086073993367803% max_drawdown -0.20086073993367803, 63 trades) within 1e-6 / exact trades or STOP the run.

dd_guard_policy.rule: All 4 filter variants x both sizings = 8 pre-specified branches. dd_guard reference is THIS run's control_1x sampled equity (trade exit_time/equity_after), past-only 1-microsecond cutoff, 100.0 seed; trigger 10%, lev 0.5; applied at each branch's OWN signal times via leverage column only (geometry untouched).
dd_guard_policy.reference: control_1x this-run equity (not v03 own-book; disclosed deviation, same convention as v41/v44/v53 shared-control reference).

monthly_note: monthly/annual geometric from parent_plan duration (complete_evaluation_until minus folds[0][0], 365.2425d year), same formula as v41/v44/v53.

labels.causal: 1m bars strictly before/at signal_time only (close_time <= signal_time asserted); entry seeking still starts at t+1; no future information.
